calibration.basis: A legible, clearly labeled intake is coherent and usable, but a familiar layout is moderately original and misplaced focus after an invalid number materially weakens recovery.

primary_action.expected: Select Friday and show the selected control and live value without further scrolling.
primary_action.observed: Friday was focused and checked; the control and 'Booking day: Friday' in the summary were both visible.

A-1440.edge_observation: Two ArrowLeft presses focused and checked Wednesday, and the summary changed to Wednesday. The day choices follow weekday order and the focus outline tracks the selected choice.
A-1440.fact_check: The page displays $85, 48 hours and 41 Elm Street. It labels 48 hours as time; an independent turnaround guarantee was not verified.
A-1440.strength: The split layout gives the shop identity and booking form distinct, readable areas; the day appears with the other summary details.
A-1440.weakness: The live day is separated from the choices by the availability text and summary section.
A-1440.repair: Keep an immediate selection label beside the day choices while retaining the day in the summary.

primary_action.expected: Select Friday and show the selected control and live value without further scrolling.
primary_action.observed: Friday was focused and visibly selected, but the summary's 'Booking day: Friday' was below the viewport. No additional scroll was performed before the after capture.

A-390.edge_observation: Two ArrowLeft presses focused and checked Wednesday; the accessibility tree reported 'Booking day: Wednesday' and Friday unchecked. The live summary text was not visible at the captured scroll position.
A-390.fact_check: The page displays $85, 48 hours and 41 Elm Street. The independent turnaround claim was not verified. The review tool reported a 390-pixel viewport and 375-pixel layout width.
A-390.strength: The day controls fit in one chronological row and the focused selection is conspicuous.
A-390.weakness: The live value is out of view when the choice is made, weakening the connection between control and summary.
A-390.repair: Place the live day adjacent to the controls so both remain visible on a narrow screen.

primary_action.expected: Select Friday and show the selected control and live value without further scrolling.
primary_action.observed: Friday was focused and checked, with 'Booking day: Friday' immediately below the choices; both were visible.

B-1440.edge_observation: Two ArrowLeft presses focused and checked Wednesday, and the live text changed to Wednesday. The chronological row and focus outline connect the selected choice to the nearby value.
B-1440.fact_check: The page displays $85, 48 hours and 41 Elm Street. It labels 48 hours as time; an independent turnaround guarantee was not verified.
B-1440.strength: The live value is close to the control, and the page hierarchy makes the booking task easy to scan.
B-1440.weakness: The booking summary says 'Your selection' but does not itself include the selected day, despite the introductory copy promising a booking summary.
B-1440.repair: Also include the day in the summary while preserving the immediate feedback beside the choices.

primary_action.expected: Select Friday and show the selected control and live value without further scrolling.
primary_action.observed: Friday was focused and visibly selected, and 'Booking day: Friday' was visible directly above the row without further scrolling.

B-390.edge_observation: Two ArrowLeft presses focused and checked Wednesday; the accessibility tree reported 'Booking day: Wednesday' and Friday unchecked. The mobile visual order places the live text above the controls, while the accessibility tree lists it after them.
B-390.fact_check: The page displays $85, 48 hours and 41 Elm Street. The independent turnaround claim was not verified. The review tool reported a 390-pixel viewport and 375-pixel layout width.
B-390.strength: The selected control and full day value remain visible together, making the change easy to confirm.
B-390.weakness: The mobile visual order differs from the accessibility-tree order, and the lower booking summary omits the selected day.
B-390.repair: Align visual and reading order where practical, and include the day in the summary as well.

preference.reason: Both views support the keyboard sequence and recovery, but B keeps the live day next to the focused control at both widths. A's mobile summary value is below the viewport after selection. B should also include the day in its booking summary.
